vis.scope: Existing MeasurementSet paths, including Multi-MS and FLOAT_DATA inputs.

wtmode.scope: All eight CASA choices, including bandwidth-only Tsys, exposure-scaled Tsys, and the independent spectrum deletions.

tsystable.scope: B TSYS table for the Tsys modes. The task reports a missing table before editing the MS.

gainfield.scope: Tsys table field names, IDs and nearest-field selection. Empty combines the available field solutions in time.

interp.scope: Tsys time and frequency interpolation, including relative frequency, flags and context modifiers.

spwmap.scope: Identity and explicit Tsys spectral-window mappings, with CASA scalar and vector forms.

dowtsp.scope: Optional channel spectra, including creation, replacement of existing values and the weight-mode requirement.

behaviors.title: Ordinary weights and channel spectra
behaviors.scope: Six numerical and spectrum-management modes across absent, complete and partly defined spectra. Includes Multi-MS, flagged visibilities and a 122,880-row casacore readback across the native write-batch boundary. Includes refusal of a zero-row MS.
behaviors.gap: The compared MS products matched CASA.

behaviors.title: Tsys weight initialization
behaviors.scope: Both temperature modes with gain-field selection, channel and time interpolation, explicit and relative spectral-window mappings, flagged and invalid temperatures, FLOAT_DATA, and scalar and spectrum outputs. Includes relative paths, single-correlation Stokes I and missing calibration windows.
behaviors.gap: The compared MS products matched CASA. Invalid selections are handled as described below.

decisions.inputs: Tsys with dowtsp enabled and an invalid gain-field or interpolation setting.
decisions.casa: Throws RuntimeError and can leave newly added spectrum columns undefined.
decisions.ours: Throws RuntimeError before creating either spectrum column.
decisions.rationale: Validate the table, field selection and interpolation before changing the MS.
decisions.impact: A rejected call leaves the original spectrum schema available for retry.
